result.title: BOP-Refer: Benchmark for Monocular 3D and 2D Object Grounding
result.summary: We introduce BOP-Refer, the first benchmark for monocular 3D and 2D grounding of everyday and industrial objects sourced from 9 diverse BOP datasets. We pair images from these datasets with VLM-generated and human-verified referring expressions, and derive accurate ground-truth 3D and 2D bounding boxes of the referred objects from their 3D models and 6DoF pose annotations. Our systematic evaluation of 17 frontier VLMs across the major proprietary and open-weight families (Gemini, GPT, Claude, Qwen, Gemma) shows that the best model, Gemini 4 Carbon, reaches 72.6% AP_IoU2D in 2D but only 12.4% AP_IoU3D in 3D, despite the more lenient IoU thresholds in 3D. The predicted 3D boxes are usually centered on the target objects in the image but often off in depth by more than the object's size, suggesting that metric scale estimation, which needs reliable object size priors, is currently by far the main source of error.

AI.brief_summary: 该文构建 BOP-Refer 基准，用 9 个 BOP 数据集图像配 VLM 生成并经人工核验的指代表达，从 3D 模型与 6DoF 位姿导出 2D/3D 真值框，并系统评测 17 个前沿 VLM 的单目 2D 与 3D 定位能力。
AI.relevance_reason: 其诊断显示模型 2D 定位尚可但深度误差常超过物体尺寸，指向 VLM 内部几何与度量尺度信息保留不足，可作为检验视觉细节是否进入推理状态的证据线索，但论文本身未涉及 latent 推理机制。
